claim_scope: within-CVIAN development confirmation; label-cost Phase-1 baseline
maximum_adaptive_views_semantics: total revealed views including the fixed initial sector_0
classifier_state_enumeration: all unique subsets containing sector_0 for k=1..4
utility_decision_state_enumeration: all unique subsets containing sector_0 for k=1..3; k=4 is the acquisition cap

utility_regressor.target_formula: sum_j p_before[j] C[y,j] - sum_j p_after[j] C[y,j] - 0.5
utility_regressor.state_weighting: equal total weight per sample and revealed-view count
candidate_inputs: absolute yaw sin/cos when compass is available

adaptive_policy.claim_status: secondary risk-aware heuristic only; not risk-controlled
adaptive_policy.fail_closed_rule: STOP disabled because no independent policy-trajectory calibration role exists
adaptive_policy.q_functional_warning: candidate utility is target-conditioned soft-loss reduction while q_stop is model-implied Bayes risk; adaptive Q values are heuristic

primary_go_criterion.estimand: equal dependency-component macro operational cost at k=3
primary_go_criterion.severe_miss_estimand: equal dependency-component macro severe-miss rate at k=3
primary_go_criterion.severe_miss_definition: indicator(target=2 and prediction!=2); fixed-k3 primary policies never defer
primary_go_criterion.severe_miss_rule: the fixed-five-seed equal-component macro baseline-minus-utility contrast must be nonnegative

paired_bootstrap.pairing: resample each shared component with all five model-seed and paired-policy values intact

requirements: utility_regression lower cost than farthest in all five model seeds
utility_regression lower cost than max_building_privileged in all five model seeds
paired dependency-component bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for baseline-minus-learned is above zero for both baselines
utility_regression severe-miss rate is no worse than both baselines

test_reuse_policy: evaluate once after code, model artifacts, calibration, policies, metrics, and this config are hashed; any defect correction consumes the result and downgrades it to exploratory
attestation_revision_note: This label-cost utility model is a required baseline, not the final attestation-coverage RQ3 policy.
